Punchline: Sell smarter. Buy smarter. Learn your trading style.

Changelog:
# Should I? v1.1.2

Focused **Should I Buy?** world-safety and live-verification update based on live testing.

## Current-world safety
- Normal Buy recommendations are scoped to the world you are physically on now.
- Cached recommendations from a different visited world are hidden rather than silently shown as local opportunities.
- Changing worlds during discovery or detailed Universalis analysis discards that run.
- The opportunity detail page shows the market world explicitly.
- Cross-world trading is intentionally left for a separate explicit opt-in mode.

## Clear scan stages
- **Discover Good Buys (Universalis)** is the broad market-universe pass.
- **Detailed Universalis** fetches full listings and 90-day history only for the strongest candidate items.
- **LIVE VERIFY THIS ITEM ONLY** performs one native FFXIV ItemSearch request for the selected item and never starts the broad discovery pass.
- LIVE VERIFY warns when the Market Board/retainer market UI is not visible because the native ItemSearch proxy may not be ready.

## Usability
- Right-click item names in the Buy results, budget basket, or detail page to copy the item name to the clipboard.

Recommendations remain read-only and Should I? never automatically purchases Market Board listings.
